CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Model Architecture]
- What: Modify only model_design by adding a zero-initialized, trainable scalar bias for each item. Add this bias to the existing dot-product scores consistently in forward for positive and negative items and in score_candidates; keep padding-item bias zero.
- Why: With 131,548 training interactions across 17,566 items, learning both item popularity and sequential compatibility through the same sparse item embeddings may limit ranking quality.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: The current scoring head has no explicit item intercept, so its shared embeddings must represent both general item preference and sequence-dependent compatibility.
- Evidence: The supplied code uses only embedding dot products, and validation HR@10 reaches 0.645; these observations support testing this limitation but do not establish that missing biases caused the remaining errors.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Frozen-host BPR training will learn item intercepts jointly with the causal convolutional backbone, allowing global preference to influence rankings without requiring the sequence representation to carry it entirely. Biases start at zero, preserving the original scoring function at initialization.
- Expected improvement: Target validation HR@10 of 0.650–0.660 as an experimental hypothesis, retaining the change only if frozen-host validation improves over 0.645; each additional hit among 200 validation users changes HR@10 by 0.005.
- Synergy (if multiple changes): Not applicable; use one candidate slot for this isolated scoring-head change.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: 2024 for training; frozen validation negative-sampling seed 42.
- Data split: Identical to parent, including the same 200 validation users and 99 sampled negatives per user.
- Architecture: One causal dilated-convolution NextItNet, existing residual scales, dilation schedule, masking, normalization, tied item embeddings, and absence of positional embeddings.
- Hyperparameters: MAXLEN=128, HIDDEN_UNITS=64, NUM_BLOCKS=8, KERNEL_SIZE=3, DROPOUT_RATE=0.2, LR=0.001, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.0, BATCH_SIZE=128.
- Host behavior: Preprocessing, BPR loss, Adam, clipping, epochs, training negatives, checkpoint selection, and evaluation remain frozen.
- Contract: Preserve constructor, forward, encode_sequence, and score_candidates interfaces and all source restrictions; host checkpoint and candidate scores remain the submission.
